why: Wiring cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/wiring-1.md) logged four P2 `wiring` findings. wiring-1.6: three shipped files name three CSS entries (`init`'s to-do: `basalt-ui/tailwind.css` plus `.basalt/sources.css`; `docs/vite.md`: `sources.css` after `@import 'tailwindcss'`; `/basalt-app` steps 3-4: import the `tokens:css` and `fonts:css` output once); `tailwind.css` already imports `tailwindcss`, its own `tokens.css` and `fonts.css`, so the `src/tokens.css` `init` writes has no stated place; `docs/vite.md` uses `tailwindcss()` (`@tailwindcss/vite`, no declared peer) and `init` adds `basalt()` first and no `tailwindcss()`. wiring-1.7: `init` installs only the lint peers; doctor then names `tailwindcss`, `@base-ui/react`, `@tanstack/react-query`, and `@tailwindcss/vite` and `@tanstack/router-plugin` are named by no shipped file. wiring-1.8: run as `./node_modules/.bin/basalt-ui doctor`, the AGENTS block's own instruction, check 11 fails "Executable not found in $PATH: oxlint" with `oxlint` in `node_modules/.bin`; `init` writes `.oxfmtrc.json` without `oxfmt` (check 9 SKIPPED); in a fresh repo the ratchet says "no base ref" and names no way to give one. wiring-1.9: `agent/templates/main.tpl` imports the v3 `BasaltProvider` from `basalt-ui/core/provider`, the eject path, and no doc names it.
what: `init` installs and patches everything the `app` profile needs, doctor runs from the local bin, and the v3 provider has a documented home.
